It was contested by 12 teams, and [[Club Brugge K.V.|FC Bruges]] won the championship: however, for reasons unknown, [[K.A.A. Gent|La Gantoise]] were not relegated to the Promotion Division.<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesb/belghist.html |title=Belgium – Final Tables 1895–2008 |publisher=The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |last1=Ploquin |first1=Phil |last2=Nackaerts |first2=Luc |last3=Coolsaet |first3=Jeroen |access-date=16 December 2018}}</ref>
